name: myRep_add
prelude:
def myRep (a : α) : Nat → List α
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 => a :: myRep a n
statement: theorem myRep_add (a : α) (m n : Nat) : myRep a (m + n) = myRep a m ++ myRep a n
proofs:
induction m with
  | zero => simp [myRep]
  | succ m ih => simp [Nat.succ_add, myRep, ih]
  have rep_eq (k : Nat) : myRep a k = List.replicate k a := by
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => simp [myRep, ih, List.replicate_succ]
  rw [rep_eq, rep_eq, rep_eq, List.replicate_append_replicate]
strategies: Characterize myRep as replicate and use its concatenation identity.
